If each reset does not increase actual influence, then E D_K(leaves)>=D_K(root)-r phi(a), K>=0. With t2^k and rk/2^k->0 this retains seed deficit in expectation despite bounded-I/L2 escape; with t2^l,k2l and rl/2^l->0 it retains normalized deficit while I(root)->0 and the seed ratio survives. A positive seed deficit therefore forces at least one violating complete leaf, even after full affine resets, and all-terminal nonviolation requires maximum depth at least [t(H0-Kq)-(10+2K)k-15]/[2(k+3/ln2)] when its numerator is positive.
